fields.label: Config
fields.help: The name of the instance's configuration (similar but not quite the same as a region) which defines the geographic placement and replication of your databases in this instance.

fields.label: Default Backup Schedule Type
fields.help: Controls the default backup behavior for new databases within the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The descriptive name for this instance as it appears in UIs.

fields.label: Edition
fields.help: The edition selected for this instance.

fields.label: Force Destroy
fields.help: When deleting a spanner instance, this boolean option will delete all backups of this instance.

fields.label: Instance Type
fields.help: The type of this instance.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A unique identifier for the instance, which cannot be changed after the instance is created.

fields.label: Num Nodes
fields.help: The number of nodes allocated to this instance.

fields.label: Processing Units
fields.help: The number of processing units allocated to this instance.

fields.label: Disable High Priority Cpu Autoscaling
fields.help: If true, disables high priority CPU autoscaling for this replica and ignores high_priority_cpu_utilization_percent in the top-level autoscaling configuration.

fields.label: Disable Total Cpu Autoscaling
fields.help: If true, disables total CPU autoscaling for this replica and ignores total_cpu_utilization_percent in the top-level autoscaling configuration.
